    Amelia¶

    "It's not a pulse rifle. It's a lightning bow. And I've got hundreds of confirmed kills with it." — Amelia, age 6, to an increasingly concerned Emrys

    Amelia is a girl born in 598 AGD in the Grimmel Republic — one year after the two protagonists. She is the sole heir of the Amelia family, named after the moon, and the keeper of a relic that should not exist on Ge'or: a Pulse Rifle from the Glorious Alliance crash.

    She is essential to the story of Emrys and Lucien — not for her power, but for what she carries. The moment Emrys sees her weapon and says "what the fuck is this pulse rifle doing here" is the moment his past-life memory first breaks through the surface.

    Appearance¶

    Amelia wears blue maid clothes — practical, feminine, slightly worn at the edges. Her demeanor is sharp, prideful, and easily flustered. A tsundere through and through: she will insult you while making sure you've eaten.

    Personality¶

    • Tsundere. Brags about her kills. Gets annoyed when someone outdoes her. Blushes when thanked.
    • Fierce. She hunted wild animals with a pulse rifle at age five. She's not fragile — she's small, which is different.
    • Proud of her lineage. The rifle is her birthright. She will tell you its history, but only if you earn it.
    • Bothered by being saved. When Emrys killed the goblins in the ravine, her first reaction was not gratitude — it was irritation that she didn't get to do it.

    Biography¶

    The Amelia Family Lineage¶

    The Amelia family traces its name to Amelia, the Daughter Moon — a tradition of moon-naming among the old families of Grimmel. They were hunters, trappers, and scavengers who worked the cave systems of the western hills.

    In 377 AGD, an ancestor — a hunter whose name is lost — explored a cave deeper than any before. Inside, half-buried in sediment deposited over fifteen thousand years, was a weapon: a Pulse Rifle from the Glorious Alliance crash. It still worked. The magic of Ge'or had kept its circuits alive.

    The hunter discovered its use by accident — a pull of the trigger, a bolt of concentrated magic, a dead warg at forty paces. He called it a lightning bow. The name stuck.

    Inheritance¶

    The rifle was passed from parent to child for over two hundred years — a secret weapon, a family treasure, a hunting tool. By the time Amelia was born in 598 AGD, it had been in the family for eleven generations.

    Her father died when she was four years old (602 AGD). On his deathbed, he pressed the rifle into her hands. She was the only child. The only daughter. The last of the line.

    She has carried it ever since.

    Meeting Emrys¶

    Amelia was six when she met Emrys — another child of Grimmel, born the year before her. He was quiet, watchful, and the moment he saw her lightning bow, something in his face changed.

    "What the fuck is this pulse rifle doing here."

    She corrected him: it was a lightning bow. He didn't let it go. He followed her. Watched her. Asked questions no six-year-old should know how to ask. She found him annoying.

    She also didn't send him away.

    The Ravine¶

    Three months into their strange friendship, Amelia went alone to a grove she knew — a place where a particular fruit grew, sweet and rare. She fell into a ravine by accident. Ten Goblins found her before she could climb out.

    Emrys had been following her. He always followed her. He killed all ten with a lightning spell — precise, brutal, efficient. He was six years old.

    Amelia emerged from the ravine furious. Not at the goblins. At him. She could have handled it. She had her lightning bow. He stole her kills.

    But she also told him the truth after that — the cave, the ancestor, the family line, the deathbed. Everything. Because if he was going to keep saving her life, he deserved to know what he was saving.

    Aftermath¶

    Amelia's mother adored Emrys after the ravine. She invited him to everything — dinners, hunts, family gatherings. He became a fixture in their home. Amelia pretended to hate it. She didn't.

    The Pulse Rifle¶

    See: Pulse Rifle

    Amelia's rifle is one of fewer than ten surviving pulse weapons on Ge'or. It fires concentrated magic drawn from the user's own reserves — no ammunition, no reloading, just will and trigger pull. She has used it to hunt wargs, gnolls, and small game since she was five.

    She calls it a lightning bow. She will not be corrected.

    Her claim of "hundreds of confirmed kills" is exaggerated. Most were rabbits.
